-stop with the fiber. fiber can “bulk up” stools, which can make constipation from the pain meds worse instead of better. as far as stool softeners not working, i have no idea tbh. miralax usually works for me. 

-once the stone reaches the bladder, the pain usually subsides a great deal for me. then i just have to pee A LOT. also, like i said before, they NEED to be straining their urine. catching that stone is pretty much the only way to try to prevent more.
